method: New high-resolution code-drawn raster reconstruction from exact-model official photographs; no photograph crop or resized product image used as a texture. Only final PNG is distributed.
limitations: Typeface, shade, drawing stroke, reconstructed diagram placement and physical registration are visual reconstructions.

All readable front/back port names, Bypass/Separate print, UART coloured pin key, DIN pin numbers and TRS diagram labels are transcribed from own U187 photos. Printed routing text is preserved as observed and is not a promise of electrical behavior.
No serial, QR, vendor vector source, private table or source download link is included.
No separate interface sticker was observed on the two DIN or three TRS socket rims; their port roles are indicated by front/back labels.
